name: OMAN Reinsurance SAOG
hq: Coral Building, 6th Floor Al Khuwair South Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
description: Oman Reinsurance Company SAOG (Oman Re), incorporated in August 2008 and listed on the MSX following its 2021 IPO, is the first reinsurance company established in the Sultanate of Oman. Operating from its Muscat headquarters and a Qatar Financial Centre (QFC) branch launched in August 2021, Oman Re underwrites both Facultative and Treaty reinsurance across the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Central and Eastern Europe, and CIS markets. Its underwriting portfolio spans property and renewable energy, onshore and offshore energy, engineering (CAR/EAR/CPM/EEI), marine hull and cargo, miscellaneous accident, motor, casualty, and specialty lines.
highlights: Scaled consistently from OMR 5 million initial paid-up capital to OMR 30 million+, reaching OMR 56.1 million in gross written premiums and OMR 49.9 million in reinsurance revenue.
Reported 58% year-on-year growth in net profit after tax for 9M 2026 following strong Q1 (+59%) and H1 (+49%) underwriting momentum.
